description: trust evaluation with device kinds (intro v2): trusted_set_by_kind plus the revoke-from-base restriction. See README.md for the case schema

cases.name: runner_wins_desktop_first
cases.note: A vouches X as desktop and as runner; the result is runner whatever the order, with a conflict

cases.name: runner_wins_runner_first
cases.note: same intros in the reverse order

cases.name: demotion_rerun_drops_what_the_demoted_vouched_for
cases.note: A vouches X as desktop, X vouches Y, B vouches X as runner: X is demoted and Y falls out

cases.name: m3_a_candidate_from_a_demoted_signer_does_not_survive
cases.note: X (pinned, desktop) names pinned Y desktop, B names X runner: Y keeps no kind after X is demoted

cases.name: chain_settles_in_four_passes
cases.note: A -> X -> Y -> Z, each step needs the kind learned in the previous pass

cases.name: cap_reached_raises_trust_unstable_and_keeps_only_own
cases.note: the same chain with max_passes 1: unstable, only the own key stays trusted, no kinds

cases.name: order_independence_reversed_chain
cases.note: the chain intros in reverse order give the same output

cases.name: self_intro_yields_no_kind
cases.note: self-intros (X says mobile, A says mobile) never give a kind, not even to their signer

cases.name: v1_counts_for_a_target_with_a_known_kind
cases.note: gate closed: A's v1 intro admits X whose kind is known, and gives no kind

cases.name: v1_ignored_for_a_target_of_unknown_kind
cases.note: A's v1 intro for X is ignored because X has no known kind

cases.name: v1_ignored_once_the_gate_is_open
cases.note: A and X both show a counted v2 self-intro, so the gate opens and the v1 intro for X no longer counts

cases.name: tie_desktop_vs_mobile_without_an_existing_kind
cases.note: A says X desktop, B says X mobile, X has no kind: the kind stays unknown and a conflict is raised

cases.name: tie_desktop_vs_mobile_keeps_the_existing_kind
cases.note: X is already desktop; a mobile claim only raises a conflict

cases.name: m1_revoke_from_base_never_trusts_what_was_untrusted_before
cases.note: root A has no known kind and vouches D as desktop; D was not trusted before the revoke: D stays out and no kind is stored

cases.name: m1_revoke_from_base_keeps_what_was_trusted_before_without_learning_its_kind
cases.note: same intro, D was trusted before: D stays, but the kind the unknown-kind root vouched is not stored

cases.name: m1_revoke_from_base_may_lower_a_known_kind
cases.note: X was desktop; B vouches X as runner: X stays and is lowered to runner
